name: dogfood-observability-llm-ops-app
description: Dogfood app v1.42-3 — an LLM observability harness (OTel GenAI 2026-06 stable semantic conventions) driven behind a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa/observability v2.2 advanced III semantics (LLM-obs axis: countTokens + logPrompt + flagHallucination + checkBudget) + real-driver env-gate. Two adapter implementations satisfy the same 10-op contract: makeMockAdapter walks the observability v2.2 LLM-obs state machine deterministically without any backend; makeRealAdapter emits an OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock style completion API sequence through the KIWA_MODE=real testcontainers-driven stack when KIWA_LLM_PROVIDER_URL / KIWA_LLM_METRICS_URL / KIWA_LLM_BUDGET_API_URL are wired, and otherwise reports KIWA_LLM_ENV_MISSING so callers can budget the fallback. The fidelity harness diffs both traces side-by-side across 3 LLM lifecycle stages (token / prompt / budget) x 4 observability targets (grafana-oss / prometheus / loki / otel-collector) so behavioural drift between mock semantics and real completion + metrics + budget APIs stays observable and feeds the @kiwa/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/observability -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
